output.reason: The cluster combines two upgrade-guide sections that document different changes. One is the removal of the compactor flags `-boltdb.shipper.compactor.shared-store` and `.key-prefix` [ev-c569cd56f9ef, ev-ca57f615b9c9, ev-cf8ca5687050]. The other is the removal of the shipper flags `-boltdb/-tsdb.shipper.shared-store` and `.key-prefix`, which has its own exposure conditions and consequences, including lost index access when the shared store does not match `object_store` [ev-43cc6d389282, ev-7d2769e8c602, ev-af5a4b32c120]. For the titled compactor change, the evidence names the subject and the removal, and says the compactor now runs compaction and retention on every object store in the period configs. It does not say what happens to an operator who still sets those flags or whose setup relied on them, so neither the consequence nor who is exposed can be written. The cluster needs to be split into the compactor and shipper changes, and the compactor change needs evidence of what happens when the operator does nothing.
